cells.gaps: No exact figure for women has been found: the 2023-24 health survey summary gives men's internet use, and more than 4 in 10 for women.
cells.note: No figure for the gender gap in internet use, of any year, has been found. The 2023-24 DHS synthesis gives men's use (61 per cent in the last 12 months) but only more than 4 in 10 for women, so no gap can be computed.
